#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

class DNekoIPrank {
public:
    const int mod = 1000000007;

    int solve(int n) {
        vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(2 * n + 1, vector<vector<int>>(2 * n + 1, vector<int>(2, 0)));
        dp[0][0][0] = 1;
        for (int depth = 1; depth <= 2 * n; ++depth) {
            for (int opened = (depth & 1); opened <= depth; opened += 2) {
                if (opened - 1 >= 0) {
                    dp[depth][opened][0] += dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][1];
                    dp[depth][opened][1] += dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][0];
                }
                if (opened + 1 <= n) {
                    dp[depth][opened][0] += dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][1];
                    dp[depth][opened][1] += dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][0];
                }
                ++dp[depth][opened][0];
                ++dp[depth][opened][1];
                dp[depth][opened][0] %= mod;
                dp[depth][opened][1] %= mod;
            }
        }
        return dp[2 * n][0][1];
    }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    DNekoIPrank solver;
    cout << solver.solve(n);
    return 0;
}
